name: Jamaica Cultural Expo / Seville programme
description: JTB lists a Seville programme on 14 October. Confirm the specific day's public programme and registration with the organiser; the wider expo has separate activities.
call: A local cultural option worth checking before setting your day. Do not assume normal park-tour hours apply to the expo.
cost: Registration and current admission: check organiser.

name: BZR WKND 2026
location: Kingston; JTB identifies National Stadium for the headline event
description: Four-day music and entertainment programme. Individual parties have separate venues and tickets; confirm each event rather than treating the stadium as the whole weekend's location.
call: An overnight Kingston plan, not an easy addition to an Ocho Rios beach afternoon.
cost: Event-specific ticket categories; organiser confirmation required.

name: Women With a Purpose Breast Cancer 5K Run/Walk
description: Community run/walk listed by JTB for 18 October. Check the organiser's registration, starting point and race-day arrangements.
call: Plan a South Coast stay if this is your reason for travel; do not compress it into a north-coast half-day.

name: National Heroes’ Day
location: National public holiday; programmes vary by parish
description: The third Monday in October falls on 19 October in 2026. This is a holiday notice, not a promise of a particular concert or ceremony.
call: Check local programmes and opening hours. Seville's normal tour page excludes public holidays.
cost: Venue-specific; no national event admission price.

name: Treasure Beach Food, Rum & Reggae Festival
location: Treasure Beach / South Coast, St. Elizabeth
description: Food, rum and music weekend listed by JTB for 6–8 November. Confirm the programme, admission and exact venue with the organiser.
call: Make it a South Coast weekend rather than a long return excursion from Ocho Rios.

name: Jamaica Pro-Am: Annie’s Revenge
description: Golf event listed by JTB for 18–22 November. Entry packages, playing venues and visitor attendance differ; obtain the organiser's current schedule.
call: Relevant for golfers planning a separate western stay; not a general walk-in north-coast activity.

name: Mouttet Mile Invitational
description: Race-day event listed for 5 December. Check admission, transport and the full programme through the organiser.
call: Plan transport and a separate day; racing hospitality packages are different from basic admission.
cost: Current admission and hospitality categories through organiser.

name: Reggae Marathon: half marathon, 10K & 5K
description: The organiser confirms 6 December 2026 in Kingston. Its FAQ distinguishes the in-person distances from the full marathon, offered virtually.
call: Use Kingston accommodation and the actual race instructions. Older Negril descriptions are not the 2026 location.
cost: Distance/category registration fees on organiser's site.
